Confirmed the crash_signature this helper builds IS consumed downstream: backend_poll.py:1072-1114 reads result.crash_signature for the CUDA-IMA (_crash_signature_is_cuda_ima) and OUR_CODE_FRAME (_crash_signature_has_our_code_frame) failover predicates — so a stale-tail signature genuinely misinforms a failover/respawn decision. - Bug 2 (PHANTOM, deflect): DONE_QUOTED_NOISE_RE (poll_pipeline.py:309-312) = phase=done negation-words | rc=[1-9]\d* — does NOT match '(0 failed)'. Grepped the WHOLE scripts/ tree for a bare-failed error scanner (re.compile.*fail, errored, traceback). The only crash-signature classifier is failure_classifier.py, whose regexes are ALL anchored (CUDA out of memory:62/123, OOM-killer|Killed:63, RuntimeError: CUDA error:71, Failed to initialize.*vllm:72, Traceback.*library:94) — none matches a bare 'failed' substring. No scanner in autonomous_session_watch or any other script greps '(0 failed)'. Deflection is complete and stands.

Methodology (design): poller-side tail-selection fix is the correct design vs dispatcher-canonical-log — dispatchers legitimately write per-phase/shard logs and the probe already reads them for mtime; extending tail coverage to match mtime coverage is the minimal symmetric change on the SHARED probe (covers all lanes routing through it). mtime-argmax edge cases handled: max() with default=(mtime_epoch, log_tail) falls to main log on tie/empty; the 'if t' filter drops empty tails; globs unchanged (narrow issue-<N>-* / issue_<N> patterns already vetted vs cross-pod pollution). Two extra tail -500 on already-selected freshest files is safe under the 60s ssh timeout. No blocking flaw.

Alternatives: no cheaper correct fix missed. 'Always tail every log the mtime probe touched' == what the fix does for the freshest one; moving selection to poll_once buys nothing (helper is already pure + called from poll_once). Design is minimal.

Not a design flaw — the fix is straightforward and the plan's must-ask/deviations give room — but the design prose should be corrected so the implementer sizes the edit right.
